hook_text: It looks like Namaqualand. But no human has ever stood there. Meet the robots of Mars!
clip_script: Springbok's red hills look like Mars. But Mars is freezing, the air is thin, and it's seven months away. Signals take minutes, so no joystick! Rovers drive themselves. Six wheels on bendy legs. Cameras for eyes. An arm with a drill. Solar panels or nuclear power. Opportunity drove more than a marathon. Perseverance brought a helicopter! And they found it: old rivers and lakes. Mars was once wet!
visual_style: Whiteboard split screen of the Namaqualand hills and a Mars landscape, then a six-wheeled rover with labelled parts.
mood: Adventurous and curious, like a space detective story.
pacing: Quick contrast, then rover parts one by one, then the big discovery.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and design a rover part that solves a Mars problem.
